name: Maggie Bove-Lamonica
office: City of Hermosa Beach, Member of the City Council

items.text: Maggie Bove-LaMonica is an attorney and a member of the Hermosa Beach City School District board, where she has served 13 years. She says she helped turn a deficit into financial stability while managing budgets of more than $100 million and delivering $87 million in voter-approved school bonds.

sentences.text: Maggie Bove-LaMonica is an attorney and a member of the Hermosa Beach City School District board, where she has served 13 years.
She says she helped turn a deficit into financial stability while managing budgets of more than $100 million and delivering $87 million in voter-approved school bonds.

items.text: She supports the half-cent sales tax on the November ballot. She proposes an outside audit of city staffing and a strategic plan, and she would pursue grants and federal infrastructure money. She also wants a public governance calendar and earlier community input on housing mandates. On business, she wants to monitor downtown vacancies and reduce permit delays.
